svg.title: Calm, Chaos and Nebula
svg.desc: Calm, key 1: 3 particles per frame, up to 900, speed 0.6 to 1.8, life 140 to 220 frames, a ring every 22 frames, trail wash alpha 45. Chaos, key 2: 8 per frame, up to 1,400, speed 1.4 to 3.8, life 90 to 160 frames, a ring every 10 frames, wash alpha 25. Nebula, key 3: 5 per frame, up to 1,200, speed 0.9 to 2.6, life 120 to 200 frames, a ring every 16 frames, wash alpha 35, rainbow colours that add up where they overlap.
